title: New options for video and live transcription
summary:
New video and live transcription models landed alongside file links for hosted agents, refreshed Discord bots, and a round of model-catalog repairs.

Added paid-only Kling 4.0 Flash for 720p video with native audio, from text or a start image. Paid-only Gemini 3.5 Transcribe Live accepts streamed audio and returns interim text and a final transcript after each manually committed utterance.

Hosted prompt and code agents now accept public HTTPS file links as `input_file` parts on `/v1/responses`. The link reaches the agent as text for its tools; the file is not fetched. A community fix also caps ffmpeg-mcp runs at 16 source URLs.

CatGPT switched to GPT-6.1 Terra, and Opposite Prompt switched to GPT-6 Luna. Both now generate images with GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst and attach them as JPEGs.

daily.title: Kling 4.0 Flash video
daily.text: Generate paid-only 720p videos with native audio from text or a start image using `kwaivgi/kling-v4.0-flash`, with durations from 3 to 20 seconds. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=kwaivgi/kling-v4.0-flash).

daily.title: Gemini live transcription
daily.text: Stream mono PCM16 audio to paid-only `google/gemini-3.5-transcribe-live` and manually commit each utterance to get interim text and a final verbatim transcript. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=google/gemini-3.5-transcribe-live).

daily.title: File links for hosted agents
daily.text: Send a public HTTPS `file_url` as an `input_file` part on `/v1/responses` so hosted agents can pass the link to their tools; the file is not fetched, and the full URL reaches the model. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Fresh models for Discord bots
daily.text: CatGPT now uses GPT-6.1 Terra, while Opposite Prompt uses GPT-6 Luna. Both generate images with GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst and attach them as JPEGs.
